build_prepare_face_models: build face recognition models from a model path on a specified device and data type
create_process_face_embeddings: create face embeddings from an RGB image using CLIP vision model and insightface
create_process_face_embeddings_infer: create face embeddings from an image file path for inference with alignment
run_resize_numpy_image_long: run image resizing to a specified long edge while maintaining aspect ratio
run_img2tensor: run conversion of numpy image arrays to PyTorch tensors with BGR-to-RGB conversion
